text:
elaine: Quick huddle note: customers keep asking for stable outbound IPs + an installer that requires minimal netops involvement. We need a thin MVP decision and explicit acceptance criteria.

darren: Agreed. Proposal: MVP network slice = (A) egress pinning (single IP or small CIDR), (B) zero-touch installer with reasonable defaults, (C) preflight checks that give actionable fixes. No BGP/dynamic peering in MVP.

kiara: Implementation options: operator-relay (fast to ship, host a small proxy) vs. customer SNAT rules (less infra on us but requires customer changes). Relay tradeoff = additional latency and support surface.

sam: From pilots: two customers insist on no traffic hairpin (they want egress to appear from their IP space). Can we support both modes but document the differences and default to relay for behind-NAT installs?

ops-bot: CI: operator-bundle-2026-05-05-2 built. smoke: 20/22 passed. failures: windows preflight port-check flaky on ICMP tests.

jun: Acceptance criteria for MVP: 1) preflight must catch and explain blocked ports; 2) installer can configure egress pinning and persist across upgrades; 3) BYOK for at-rest keys with clear doc; 4) rollout plan defined (dogfood -> pilots -> GA).

zoe: UX ask: add a single "Network status" card in admin console showing egress mode (relay/SNAT), pinned IPs, and a one-click "Retry preflight" action. Link to remediation steps. Keep copy simple for netops.

darren: Upgrade path: in-place operator bundle upgrades + downloadable airgap bundle. Must guarantee pinned egress doesn't flip during upgrade; include a rollback path.

kiara: Perf note: relay adds ~50-100ms depending on region. We'll publish a short perf table and add a per-tenant latency threshold that triggers a local fallback (e.g., route to local model) if breached.

elaine: Action items: kiara -> relay vs SNAT runbook + perf matrix by Fri; jun -> draft MVP acceptance checklist + rollout gates by Thu; zoe -> mock for Network status card by Wed; sam -> align pilots on expected behavior and comms by Wed. I'll add this to the private-deploy roadmap doc and tag owners. :thumbsup:
